ling-01: I bow to that Sadashiva linga worshipped by Brahma, Vishnu and the gods; pure and radiant; destroyer of the sorrow of birth.
ling-02: I bow to that Sadashiva linga worshipped by gods and foremost sages; who burned Kama; ocean of compassion; destroyer of Ravana's pride.
ling-03: I bow to that Sadashiva linga anointed with all fragrances; cause of the growth of wisdom; praised by siddhas, gods and asuras.
ling-04: I bow to that Sadashiva linga adorned with gold and great gems; wrapped by the serpent-king; destroyer of Daksha's grand sacrifice.
ling-05: I bow to that Sadashiva linga smeared with saffron and sandal; beautified with a lotus garland; destroyer of accumulated sin.
ling-06: I bow to that Sadashiva linga served by hosts of gods with true feeling and devotion; whose splendour is that of a crore of suns.
ling-07: I bow to that Sadashiva linga surrounded by eight-petalled flowers; cause of all arising; destroyer of the eight poverties.
ling-08: I bow to that Sadashiva linga worshipped by the preceptor of the gods and the foremost gods; always worshipped with celestial flowers; the Supreme Self beyond the beyond.
ling-09: Whoever recites this sacred Lingashtakam in the presence of Shiva attains Shiva's world and rejoices with Shiva.
